summary: In a major milestone for human spaceflight, International Space Station astronauts deployed a solar array during the 100th U.S. spacewalk at the orbital complex, as preparations continue for Canada's first spacewalk in seven years. In commercial launch developments, SpaceX fired up its Starship upper stage ahead of its landmark Flight 15 test launch after completing a point-to-point cargo delivery mission for the U.S. Air Force, while Virgin Galactic unveiled its Apeiron Delta-class spaceplane and delayed commercial flights to the second quarter of 2027. Satellite manufacturer Argotec raised €50 million to scale small satellite production. Regarding defense and international developments, a new report details China's progress on on-orbit space weapons as the U.S. military released a new photograph of China's secretive space plane, and the Air Force Research Laboratory announced plans to award $30 million for a cislunar project next spring. Within civil space leadership, NASA named Artemis II commander Reid Wiseman as deputy director of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory and appointed Troy Asher as director of the Armstrong Flight Research Center. On the scientific front, a NASA-funded study revealed key details from Teghaza 001, a rare 4.1-billion-year-old Martian meteorite, while the Vera C. Rubin Observatory identified two hidden companion galaxies of the Milky Way. Looking ahead, space industry observers should watch for United Launch Alliance's planned return to flight with its Vulcan rocket in November following a months-long pause.
